These should be included as diplomatic/de-escalatory evidence, with their non-implementation limits preserved."},{"question_id":"1B.4","issue_type":"misleading_weight","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0013-E005","BATCH-0020-E001","BATCH-0020-E004","BATCH-0040-E002","BATCH-0040-E007"],"explanation":"The draft gives substantial space to collective meetings, votes, co-sponsorship, and training while correctly acknowledging their limits, but it does not clearly distinguish stronger evidence of formal state positions from weaker evidence of actual agreement implementation, inspection, funding, enforcement, or compliance. The answer should make clear that these items establish diplomatic support, not consequential treaty performance."},{"question_id":"1B.4","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0020-E003","BATCH-0020-E005","BATCH-0020-E006"],"explanation":"The phrase “co-sponsored or supported arms-transfer and nonproliferation initiatives” compresses distinct evidence.
